faults.quote: It can also describe spicy food
faults.why: False friend with English 'hot': chili-spicy in Thai is เผ็ด, not ร้อน.
ร้อน means 'hot', not 'warm' (which is อุ่น, as note 0 itself says).

faults.quote: (weather) Having a high temperature ... (object) Having a high temperature
faults.why: Hot weather and hot objects are the same basic temperature sense.
